description: Elections Commission - A. L. Senarathna and R. Gunawardana of the Boralesgamuwa Urban Council has Vacated his office of the Members of the United National Party
reasoning: This gazette content contains a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of the Boralesgamuwa Urban Council due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) rather than general government personnel changes.
